item.summary: When exporting diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) scans from a MR system using the Enhanced MR DICOM format, the exports contain incorrect data (diffusion directions). If the Enhanced MR DICOM export is used in conjunction with third-party software for tractography (e.g. for mapping nerve fiber pathways in the brain), the software will not be able to correctly process the DTI data for reconstruction. Product details: MR 7700; Model number (REF): 1. 782120, 2. 782153, 3. 782155, 4. 782199; Software Versions: R11, R12 and R13;
